name_zh: 萨帕塔/墨西哥/土地/自由/南方/艾米利亚诺/萨帕塔/萨帕塔
core_mode: M604 土地自由/南方游击/萨帕塔遗产/萨帕塔/墨西哥革命
description_zh: 艾米利亚诺·萨帕塔（1879-1919），墨西哥革命领导人，领导南方革命。他是一位墨西哥农场主，领导了墨西哥革命的主要领导人之一。萨帕塔提出著名的"土地属于农民"主张，领导了墨西哥南方革命。1908年，他发表了阿维拉宣言，提出了改革土地所有制和实现社会正义的纲领。他的领导下，墨西哥南方革命最终建立了革命军和卡钦塔土地改革。
description_en: Emiliano Zapata (1879-1919), leader of the Mexican Revolution, led the Southern Revolution. He was a Mexican farmer and one of the main leaders of the Mexican Revolution. Zapata put forward the famous claim that "land belongs to the peasants", leading the Southern Revolution of Mexico. In 1908, he published the Avilés Declaration, proposing reform of land ownership and realization of social justice. Under his leadership, the Southern Revolution of Mexico eventually established the Revolutionary Army and the Cardenas land reform.
reason_zh: 萨帕塔是墨西哥革命的领导人之一，通过南方革命和'土地属于农民'的口号，推动了土地改革和实现社会正义。他的领导建立了革命军和卡钦塔土地改革，体现了墨西哥革命的激进土地改革精神。
reason_en: Zapata was one of the leaders of the Mexican Revolution, through the Southern Revolution and the slogan 'land belongs to the peasants', promoted land reform and realization of social justice. His leadership established the Revolutionary Army and the Cardenas land reform, exemplified Mexican revolutionary radical land reform spirit.
